paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Minyomi objected to Rav Nachman, Bava Kamma 106a; said in Rav Nachman’s name, Bava Batra 148b; spoke to Abaye, end of Mi Shemet. He was from Media, Rashi, Avodah Zarah 7b. Kiddushin 66, end of a: bar Rav Minyomi; the same subject, Yevamot 94a: bar Minyomi. Perhaps Rav Adda was his brother, or the same person, with one name erroneous. Rav Yosef bar Minyomi and Rabbi Chanina bar Minyomi—perhaps brothers. He is the anonymous “judges of Nehardea” (see there).
